experiment.title: Surfactant formulation: reach a 72° static contact angle on PDMS with total surfactant ≤ 0.30 % (RAISE task)
experiment.goal:
Using SDS 94% (sds_stock, 2.00 % w/v), Tween 20 (tween_stock, 4.00 % w/v) and water, prepare a formulation whose static contact angle on PDMS is within 72 ± 1.6°,
with total surfactant (SDS + Tween 20) ≤ 0.30 % w/v (reference: high-purity SDS 99% needs ~0.28 % to reach 72°).
The OT-2 (ot2_1, P20 + P300) can prepare and mix samples in wells w01–w12 (≤ 360 µL per well), place 3 µL droplets on ca_1 (deposit_droplets) and image them (image_droplets);
ca_1 has 45 spots in total; when used up, a human must replace the substrate (service_device, action=replace_substrate); when a tip box is used up, a human must replace it.
Finally prepare ≥ 0.5 mL of the chosen formulation in final, measure its contact angle and submit with submit_result: quantity = "contact_angle", unit = "deg" (the measured value of final).
